newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell to 1.644 billion yuan from 1.877 billion on Thursday. The 60-day contract was the most actively traded.

The bullish domestic A share market supported trading on the interbank market on Friday, attracting some non-banking financial institutions to trade actively through the second-tier market, traders said.
They said a statement from a senior Chinese economist working with the State Staistical Bureau that he expected China's interest rates to remain fairly stable this year influenced trading.

"It seems the possibility of a cut in deposit interest rates this year is getting smaller," one trader said. "That plus the delay in cutting bank reserve ratios will prevent the interbank market rates from falling in the mid-term," one trader said.
